text: In November 2024, Linda and Lily had a heated argument regarding family responsibilities and different views on family roles, leaving Linda feeling overwhelmed and guilty. By February 2025, Lily reached out and apologized, leading to a reconnection. While they are on better terms and Linda feels relieved to have her sister involved in her wedding planning, they are still cautious about addressing unresolved issues from their past conflict.
